questions.question: Erlang qaysi sohada kuchli?
options: Telecom — massiv concurrency, fault tolerance, distributed tizimlar

questions.question: Erlang da o'zgaruvchi qanday e'lon qilinadi?
Erlang da atom nima?
options: Kichik harf yoki qo'shtirnoq bilan — ok, error, 'hello world'

questions.question: Erlang da tuple nima?
options: {ok, Value} yoki {error, Reason} — belgilangan elementlar to'plami

questions.question: Erlang da function qanday e'lon qilinadi?
Erlang da spawn nima?
options: Yangi process yaratish — Pid = spawn(fun() -> ... end)

questions.question: Erlang da ! operatori nima uchun?
options: Process ga message yuborish — Pid ! Message

questions.question: Erlang da receive nima uchun?
options: Processga kelgan xabarlarni pattern match bilan qabul qilish

questions.question: Erlang da immutable variables nima?
options: O'zgaruvchiga bir marta qiymat beriladi — Erlang single assignment

questions.question: Erlang da rebar3 nima?
options: Erlang build va package management tool — yangi loyiha, kompilatsiya, test

questions.question: Erlang da lists:map nima?
options: List elementlarini funksiya bilan transformatsiya qiladi

questions.question: Erlang da process isolation nima?
options: Processlar xotirani ulashmaydi — message passing — biri ishlamasa boshqalarga ta'sir yo'q

questions.question: Erlang da OTP nima?
options: Open Telecom Platform — gen_server, supervisor, application — fault-tolerant tizimlar

questions.question: Erlang da gen_server nima?
options: Generic server behaviour — handle_call, handle_cast, init, handle_info

questions.question: Erlang da supervisor nima?
options: Bola processlarni kuzatib, ishlamasa qayta ishga tushiruvchi process

questions.question: Erlang da one_for_one supervisor strategy nima?
options: Faqat ishlamay qolgan process qayta tiklash — boshqalarga ta'sir yo'q

questions.question: Erlang da ETS nima?
options: Erlang Term Storage — tez, in-memory table, concurrent read/write

questions.question: Erlang da Mnesia nima?
options: Distributed, in-memory/disk database — ACID, table replication

questions.question: Erlang da hot code loading nima?
options: Tizimni to'xtatmasdan yangi kod versiyasini yuklash — 9 nines availability uchun

questions.question: Erlang da binary nima?
options: Binary ma'lumotlar — <<1, 2, 3>> — network protocol uchun qulay

questions.question: Erlang da bit syntax nima uchun?
options: Binary dan ma'lumot ajratish — <<H:8, T/binary>> kabi pattern matching

questions.question: Erlang da lists:foldl nima?
options: Akkumulyator bilan chapdan o'ngga aylanish — lists:foldl(fun(E, Acc) -> ... end, Init, List)

questions.question: Erlang da error handling qanday?
options: try Expr catch Error:Reason -> ... end yoki exit, throw, error

questions.question: Erlang da link va monitor farqi?
options: link — bidirectional exit propagation; monitor — unidirectional, DOWN message

questions.question: Erlang da registered process nima?
options: Pid o'rniga atom nom bilan process — register(Name, Pid), whereis(Name)

questions.question: Erlang da application nima (OTP)?
options: To'liq OTP application — start, stop funksiyalari, supervisor tree

questions.question: Erlang da maps (Erlang 17+) nima?
options: #{key => value} — yangi kalit-qiymat ma'lumotlar tuzilmasi, dict dan farqli

questions.question: Erlang da list comprehension nima?
options: [X*2 || X <- List, X > 0] — filterlash va transformatsiya birgalikda

questions.question: Erlang da timer module nima uchun?
options: timer:send_after, timer:sleep — vaqt asosida xabar yuborish

questions.question: Erlang da process dictionary nima?
options: Har process o'zining local key-value storage — get/put — global shared emas

questions.question: Erlang da BEAM scheduler nima?
options: Reductions asosida preemptive scheduling — har process teng vaqt oladi

questions.question: Erlang da dirty NIF nima?
options: C funksiyani BEAM schedulerini bloklamsdan chaqirish — CPU intensive C kod

questions.question: Erlang da code:load_file qanday?
options: Module ni runtime da yuklash — hot code upgrade uchun

questions.question: Erlang da release nima?
options: To'liq, mustaqil, deployable Erlang tizim — BEAM + modules + config

questions.question: Erlang da appmon yoki observer nima?
options: Grafik monitoring tool — processlar, xotira, ETS jadvallari ko'rish

questions.question: Erlang da sys module nima uchun?
options: OTP process debug uchun — sys:get_state, sys:trace, sys:statistics

questions.question: Erlang da gen_statem nima?
options: Generic state machine behaviour — gen_fsm ning yangi versiyasi

questions.question: Erlang da dialyzer nima?
options: Static type analysis tool — type spec va discrepancies aniqlash

questions.question: Erlang da -spec nima uchun?
options: Funksiya tip spesifikatsiyasi — Dialyzer va dokumentatsiya uchun

questions.question: Erlang da global module nima?
options: Distributed Erlang da global process registration — global:register_name

questions.question: Erlang da pg (process groups) nima?
options: Distributed process grouping — pub/sub uchun, pg2 dan yangi

questions.question: Erlang da inet module nima?
options: Network (TCP/UDP) ishlash uchun — gen_tcp, gen_udp asosi

questions.question: Erlang da cowboy nima?
options: Kichik, tez HTTP server — WebSocket, REST API uchun

questions.question: Erlang da SASL nima?
options: System Architecture Support Libraries — progress, error, crash reporting
